summary: Russian forces struck infrastructure in Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, and Odessa regions with missiles, causing fires and disruptions. Ukrainian officials report increased strikes on logistics centers and civilian targets. Fighting persists in eastern frontlines with Russian advances in Kupiansky district.

sections.threat_assessment: Russian military continues systematic strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian targets, demonstrating capability to disrupt critical systems. Recent attacks on healthcare facilities and logistics centers suggest escalation in targeting civilian infrastructure. Ukrainian countermeasures appear limited by Western aid delays, particularly in air defense capabilities.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian government seeks increased Western military aid, particularly Patriot missile systems, while pursuing EU agricultural funding. Russian military operations focus on eastern frontlines with intensified strikes on infrastructure. International sanctions against Russian supporters expand to include cybercriminals and KNDR/Iranian entities.
sections.intelligence_notes: Persistent Russian strikes on infrastructure indicate prioritization of economic warfare alongside conventional combat. Ukrainian military reports suggest ongoing challenges in maintaining supply lines and operational readiness. Russian military claims about destroying logistics centers may aim to disrupt Ukrainian operational capacity. Civilian casualties in border regions highlight continued targeting of non-combatant populations.
